news.summaryTr: Borsa İstanbul'da 7 şirketten yeni iş, yatırım ve finansman açıklaması geldi. Yapı Kredi 933 milyon dolarlık kredi sağlarken, Aksa Enerji Gabon'da kapasite artırdı. Kardemir Çelik GES kredisi aldı, Halkbank 14,8 milyar TL'lik devri tamamladı.
news.articleText: Borsa İstanbul’da 7 şirketten KAP açıklaması: Milyarlık anlaşmalar ve yeni yatırımlar Borsa İstanbul'da 7 şirketten yeni iş, yatırım ve finansman açıklaması geldi. Yapı Kredi 933 milyon dolarlık kredi sağlarken, Aksa Enerji Gabon'da kapasite artırdı. Kardemir Çelik GES kredisi aldı, Halkbank 14,8 milyar TL'lik devri tamamladı. YAPI KREDİ'DEN 933 MİLYON DOLARLIK SENDİKASYON KREDİSİ Yapı ve Kredi Bankası (YKBNK), 18 ülkeden 40 finansal kurumun katılımıyla yaklaşık 933 milyon dolar tutarında sendikasyon kredisi anlaşması imzaladı. Dört ayrı dilimden oluşan kredinin 367 gün vadeli kısmında 349 milyon dolar ve 356,5 milyon avro, 734 gün vadeli kısmında ise 97 milyon dolar ve 77 milyon avro finansman sağlandı. 367 gün vadeli dolar ve avro dilimlerinin maliyeti sırasıyla SOFR + yüzde 1,25 ve Euribor + yüzde 1 olurken, 734 gün vadeli dilimlerde maliyet SOFR + yüzde 1,75 ve Euribor + yüzde 1,45 olarak gerçekleşti. PEGASUS EKİMDE 4,21 MİLYON YOLCU TAŞIDI Pegasus Hava Taşımacılığı (PGSUS), Ekim 2026 trafik sonuçlarını açıkladı. Şirketin toplam yolcu sayısı geçen yılın aynı ayına göre yüzde 4 artarak 4,21 milyona yükseldi. İç hatlarda yolcu sayısı yüzde 14 artışla 1,55 milyona çıkarken, dış hatlarda yüzde 1 düşüşle 2,66 milyon oldu. Toplam doluluk oranı ise 0,5 puan gerileyerek yüzde 88,2 olarak gerçekleşti. Pegasus'un Ocak-Ekim dönemindeki toplam yolcu sayısı da yıllık yüzde 5 artışla 37,64 milyona ulaştı. AKSA ENERJİ'DEN GABON'DA 80 MW'LIK KAPASİTE ARTIŞI Aksa Enerji (AKSEN), Gabon Cumhuriyeti Elektrik Kurumu SEEG ile imzaladığı ek protokolle Libreville'deki elektrik santralinin kurulu gücünü 80 MW artırma kararı aldı. Daha önce 100 MW Libreville ve 45 MW Port Gentil olmak üzere toplam 145 MW kapasiteli santrallerin kurulması ve işletilmesi için anlaşma imzalayan şirket, yeni düzenlemeyle Libreville'deki toplam kapasiteyi 180 MW'a çıkaracak. Ek protokolle anlaşmanın süresi 10 yıldan 15 yıla uzatıldı. Mevcut 145 MW'lık santrallerin 2026 sonuna, ilave 80 MW'lık kapasitenin ise 2028 sonuna kadar devreye alınması planlanıyor. AYES ÇELİK'İN ALİAĞA FABRİKASINDA ÜRETİM BAŞLADI Ayes Çelik Hasır ve Çit Sanayi (AYES), yatırım sürecini tamamladığı Aliağa fabrikasında üretime başladığını duyurdu. Şirketin açıklamasına göre fabrikadaki kurulum, test ve devreye alma çalışmaları başarıyla tamamlandı. Böylece tesiste üretim faaliyetine geçildi. QUICK SİGORTA 10 AYLIK PRİM ÜRETİMİNİ AÇIKLADI Quick Sigorta (QUICK), 1 Ocak-31 Ekim 2026 dönemine ilişkin brüt yazılan prim üretimi bilgilerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda paylaştı. Şirketin açıklamasında ana sigorta branşları itibarıyla düzenlenen ve henüz denetimden geçmemiş prim üretimi verilerine yer verildi. Ancak paylaşılan metinde branş bazındaki prim tutarları bulunmuyor. KARDEMİR ÇELİK'TEN 14 MİLYON EUROLUK GES KREDİSİ Kardemir Çelik Sanayi (KARCL), Van ve Muş'ta gerçekleştireceği toplam 28,11 MWp kurulu gücündeki güneş enerjisi santrali yatırımları için 13 milyon 986 bin 926 avroluk kredi sözleşmesi imzaladı. DZ Bank AG Deutsche ile 5 Kasım 2026 tarihinde imzalanan sözleşme, Sinosure sigortası kapsamında gerçekleştirildi. Kredinin geri ödeme vadesi 9,5 yıl olarak belirlendi. Şirket, GES projelerinin sözleşme tarihinden itibaren yaklaşık 7 ay içinde tamamen devreye alınmasını bekliyor. Yatırımın enerji maliyetlerini düşürmesi ve kârlılığa katkı sağlaması hedefleniyor. HALKBANK, HALK KATILIM BANKASI'NI 14,8 MİLYAR TL'YE DEVRETTİ Halkbank (HALKB), sermayesinin yüzde 99,99'una sahip olduğu Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki paylarının tamamını TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları A.Ş.'ye devretti. Devir işlemleri 10 Kasım 2026 itibarıyla tamamlandı. İşlemin toplam tutarı 14 milyar 799 milyon 999 bin 995,72 TL olarak açıklanırken, satış sonucunda 39 milyon 923 bin 999,72 TL kâr oluştu. Devir sonrasında Halkbank'ın Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki iştirak oranı ve oy hakkı sıfıra indi. İşlem için BDDK izni 22 Ekim 2026 tarihinde alınmıştı.

news.title: Ziraat Bankası'nın 3.çeyrek net kârı 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi: İşte bilanço detayları
news.summary: Ziraat Bankası, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 50,3 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Bankanın net faiz geliri yıllık bazda 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye, net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri ise 22,9 milyar TL'den 29,9 milyar TL'ye çıktı.

news.titleTr: Ziraat Bankası'nın 3.çeyrek net kârı 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi: İşte bilanço detayları
news.summaryTr: Ziraat Bankası, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 50,3 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Bankanın net faiz geliri yıllık bazda 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye, net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri ise 22,9 milyar TL'den 29,9 milyar TL'ye çıktı.
news.articleText: Ziraat Bankası'nın 3.çeyrek net kârı 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi: İşte bilanço detayları YAYIN TARİHİ, 10 Kasım 2026 20:07 PAYLAŞ - Ziraat Bankası, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 50,3 milyar TL net kâr açıkladı. Bankanın net faiz geliri yıllık bazda 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye, net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri ise 22,9 milyar TL'den 29,9 milyar TL'ye çıktı. Türkiye Cumhuriyeti Ziraat Bankası, 2026 yılının üçüncü çeyreğine ilişkin finansal sonuçlarını açıkladı. Bankanın net kârı, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 49,7 milyar TL seviyesinden 50,3 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Net faiz geliri 123,4 milyar TL'ye çıktı CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Ziraat Bankası'nın üçüncü çeyrekte elde ettiği net faiz geliri, geçen yılın aynı dönemindeki 85,5 milyar TL'den 123,4 milyar TL'ye yükseldi. Bankanın net ücret ve komisyon gelirleri de yıllık bazda artış gösterdi. Geçen yılın aynı döneminde 22,9 milyar TL olan gelir, 2026'nın üçüncü çeyreğinde 29,9 milyar TL olarak gerçekleşti. Kredi hacmi 5,5 trilyon TL'ye ulaştı Ziraat Bankası'nın üçüncü çeyrek sonu itibarıyla toplam kredi hacmi 5,5 trilyon TL'ye yükseldi. Bankanın kredi büyüklüğü, 2025 yıl sonundaki 4,2 trilyon TL seviyesine kıyasla artış kaydetti.

news.title: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash
news.summary: The contents of the calendar, including hair clips and keychains, have been widely criticised on social media.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash
news.summaryTr: The contents of the calendar, including hair clips and keychains, have been widely criticised on social media.
news.articleText: Kim Kardashian's Skims offers refunds for $148 advent calendar after backlash - Published Kim Kardashian's Skims is offering customers refunds for its $148 (£110) advent calendar which has been widely criticised on social media. The accessories advent calendar promised "twelve days of fun surprises" but has been mocked online for the quality of its contents, such as hair clips and keychains, with some comparing them to something you would find down the back of a sofa. A spokesperson for Skims has told a number of media outlets "for some, the calendar didn't meet expectations" and the company has "personally contacted every customer" to offer a full refund or credit to put towards other products". The BBC has contacted Skims for comment. The shapewear and clothing business was co-founded by Kardashian in 2019 and has made the reality TV star a billionaire, according to Forbes magazine. Skims was valued at $5bn in 2025 when it raised millions of dollars in new funding. One account on TikTok called spicychathouse compared the contents of the calendar to things "my cat collects from around my house". Another account said it looked like "a bunch of stuff that Kim Kardashian was emptying out of her bedside table". A number of accounts showed people cleaning out their own sofas and claiming they had accidentally created the Skims advent calendar. "It is really interesting to see this kind of backlash," said Kate Vlietstra, senior director of food and drink at market research analyst Mintel. "It is something we have been seeing a bit more in recent years, particularly with the trend for unboxing on social media," she said, "It means that, inevitably, if people are not feeling they're getting the value that they have hoped for from the advent calendar...they've purchased, then yes, there is going to be a backlash." Advent calendars remain popular, according to Helen Wing, head of innovation at market research company Ipsos though she said that "the buzz around them has reduced a little bit". She said according to Ipsos research, people are willing to pay a bit more for an advent calendar but the contents have to justify the price tag. Using a £285 advent calendar sold by Liberty as an example, Wing said the upmarket department story is "very open about the value of the contents". "They will say there is over £1,000 worth of content," she said. "If you've got that reassurance when you're making the purchase, particularly if it is for a gift, then it is important to have some faith that the contents are actually going to be worth the money that you're paying." PEUGEOT KASIM 2026 FİYATLARI VE KAMPANYALARI Peugeot, Kasım 2026 döneminde sıfır otomobil modellerinin güncel fiyatlarını ve finansman kampanyalarını duyurdu. Markanın SUV modelleri 2008, 3008 ve 5008'de dikkat çeken kredi seçenekleri sunulurken, 3008'in kampanyalı fiyatı 2 milyon 755 bin TL'ye geriledi. İşte Peugeot'nun kasım ayı fiyat listesi ve kampanyaları... PEUGEOT MODELLERİNİN KASIM 2026 FİYATLARI E-208 ALACAKLARA 300 BİN TL KREDİ VE NAKİT İNDİRİMİ Peugeot E-208 için kasım ayında iki farklı avantaj sunuluyor: - Kredi seçeneği: 300 bin TL, 12 ay vade, aylık yüzde 0,99 faiz. - Nakit indirimi: Kredi kullanmak istemeyenlere 20 bin TL indirim. PEUGEOT 2008'DE 800 BİN TL KREDİ FIRSATI Peugeot 2008 modelinde ticari müşterilere yönelik finansman kampanyası bulunuyor. - Kredi seçeneği: 800 bin TL, 6 ay vade, yüzde 1,99 faiz. - Nakit indirimi: Kredi kullanılmadığında 20 bin TL'ye varan indirim. PEUGEOT 3008'DE 212 BİN TL FİYAT AVANTAJI Peugeot 3008'in güncel fiyatı 2 milyon 967 bin TL olarak açıklanırken, kampanyalı fiyatı 2 milyon 755 bin TL'ye düşüyor. Böylece modelde 212 bin TL'lik fiyat farkı oluşuyor. - Kredi seçeneği: Koç Stellantis Finansman üzerinden 1 milyon TL, 6 ay vade, yüzde 1,99 faiz. PEUGEOT 5008'E 1 MİLYON TL KREDİ Peugeot 5008 için kasım ayında dikkat çeken bir finansman seçeneği sunuluyor. - Kredi seçeneği: 1 milyon TL, 12 ay vade, yüzde 0,99 faiz. - Geçerlilik: Kampanya 5008 GT versiyonu için geçerli.

news.title: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
news.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.

news.titleTr: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government
news.summaryTr: Benjamin Netanyahu's main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot, has first chance to build a new government and oust the prime minister.
news.articleText: Israel's new parliament sworn in as leaders compete to form government - Published Israel's new parliament has been sworn in, as opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot seeks to oust caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The former army chief has been tasked with forming a government after receiving more recommendations from members of the Knesset than Netanyahu, although not all those backing him are willing to govern together. Eisenkot's bloc of four parties won 48 seats in October's election, while Netanyahu's bloc won 53, leaving both short of a majority in the 120-seat Knesset. He has 28 days to build a coalition, with a possible two-week extension. Almost half of the new MKs did not serve in the previous parliament, while Arab-led parties have a record number of seats. Shortly after they were sworn in, Netanyahu and Eisenkot warned parliament about the perils of supporting a government led by the other. "[And] to those who are thinking of establishing a government that includes supporters of terror and haters of Israel, or that will be dependent on them, I ask you, are you prepared to be dependent on those whose goal is the destruction of the Jewish state?" said Netanyahu, alluding to the prospect of an Eisenkot-led government reliant on support from Arab parties. He also appealed for the formation of a government of national unity as the only way to confront what he said was the threat of "a nuclear Iran". Eisenkot sharply criticised Netanyahu's comments. "I sat and listened to the outgoing prime minister's delusional, divisive, hate-filled and shameful speech, exploiting a state occasion," he said. "I am now even more convinced that he is unfit to remain in office for even one more minute." The outcome of the election, which was widely seen as a referendum on Netanyahu, means there is a period of uncertainty over who will form the next government. Netanyahu will remain caretaker prime minister until then - a process which could take from days to months. One of the most dramatic results was the performance of Israel's two Arab-led alliances - the United Arab List and the Joint List - which won an unprecedented 19 seats between them following a surge in turnout among Arab voters. The Arab parties could therefore hold the balance of power, although Netanyahu has ruled out governing with them and three of the parties in Eisenkot's bloc have opposed including them in a coalition. On Sunday, President Isaac Herzog tasked Eisenkot with trying to form a government. Speaking at the president's residence, the centrist Yashar party leader called for the formation of a "national emergency government" - an implicit appeal to parties to put ideological differences aside to remove Netanyahu from office. This, he said, would "require creative and unconventional political steps". Eisenkot said any party or MK prepared to accept four principles could join his proposed government. Those are recognition of Israel as a Jewish and democratic state; accepting the values of the Declaration of Independence; backing mandatory military, national or civilian service for all, including communities currently exempt; and recognising Hamas as a terrorist organisation and committing to dismantling its military and governing capabilities. The four requirements, however, could present significant obstacles to Eisenkot's potential partners. The conscription of ultra-Orthodox Jewish men, who are exempt from military service if they are in full-time religious study, was a major election issue. The ultra-Orthodox United Torah Judaism (UTJ) and Shas parties, which won 13 seats in total, have fiercely objected to attempts to change the status quo - something that all parties in Eisenkot's bloc campaigned to do. Eisenkot's four principles are also contentious for the Arab parties. Both emphasise equal national and civic rights for Israel's Arab citizens, who form about 20% of the population; the vast majority of Israeli Arabs are not required to serve in the military; and neither has publicly recognised Hamas as a terrorist organisation. The Arab parties could, though, help Eisenkot form a minority government. The United Arab List, which won eight seats, has said it is willing to be part of an Eisenkot-led coalition, while the Joint List, which won 11 seats, has offered parliamentary support from the outside. If Eisenkot accepted such an arrangement, he would still have to persuade other parties in his bloc to agree. Avigdor Lieberman, whose Yisrael Beiteinu party won seven seats, has so far refused to join a minority government dependent on Arab MKs. In return for their support, the ultra-Orthodox parties would be likely to demand major concessions on military conscription, which might be unacceptable to most of the parties in Eisenkot's bloc. news.title: Inside devastated front-line city that Russia wants Ukraine to give up
news.summary: The BBC gains rare access to a specialist drone unit defending the eastern city of Slovyansk from heavy Russian fire.

news.titleTr: Inside devastated front-line city that Russia wants Ukraine to give up
news.summaryTr: The BBC gains rare access to a specialist drone unit defending the eastern city of Slovyansk from heavy Russian fire.
news.articleText: Inside devastated front-line city that Russia wants Ukraine to give up - Published The dangers in Slovyansk are clear from the start. "If I say run, you run," Tetiana tells us. She and her colleague Yasha are escorting us into a city now under constant bombardment from Russian drones, missiles and glide bombs. It is raining and cloudy as we enter the city, and our military escorts call this "good" weather, meaning it is bad for drones. But the threat is still there, and Yasha keeps his eyes peeled on the skies, while 21-year-old Tetiana scours her phone for the latest military intelligence on likely threats from the air. They are members of a drone unit who call themselves Peaky Blinders and their distinctive emblem is a flat cap of the type made popular by the cult BBC TV series, although theirs are camouflaged. Slovyansk is one of four cities that make up Ukraine's "fortress belt" - a system of heavily reinforced defence lines in the parts of eastern region of Donetsk still under its control. Russia wants Kyiv to give up the fortress cities and they are central to talks on a possible peace deal that have resumed after nine months between Ukraine, Russia and the US in Abu Dhabi. Ukrainians worry that doing so would make it much easier for Russia to advance further west, including to the capital Kyiv. Once inside the city, we leave our vehicles hidden under the cover of trees and venture out on foot. Yasha carries a shotgun – a last resort to shoot down Russian drones. In halting English, Tetiana tells us walking is safer than travelling by car. Abandoned vehicles litter the streets – recently destroyed by remotely operated Russian first-person view drones. The anti-drone netting that covers the roads is no guarantee of safety. Tetiana shows us a video on her phone taken a few days earlier. You can hear several drones buzzing above her, and then the cacophony of small arms fire as Ukrainian forces try to shoot them down. Tetiana admits it can be scary but explains how she felt compelled to help her country, abandoning her dreams of becoming an opera singer. Slovyansk is now a husk of its former self. Very few buildings have been left unscathed, with many reduced to rubble. Tetiana shows us a school recently destroyed by Russian glide bombs. Across the road there is a gaping hole in an abandoned residential block. Broken glass litters the pavement. The few shops still functioning are boarded up – making it hard to distinguish what is still open. Most have closed. Tetiana says the Russians are doing everything they can to intimidate people and drive them out of the city. That, she says, "is their strategy – to make people leave in chaos, gathering up their last belongings and fleeing amid enormous fear and suffering. They want people to have nowhere left to live". It is a familiar pattern already seen in other Ukrainian towns and cities in the Donbas – like Pokrovsk and Bakhmut. These are now ghost towns reduced to rubble, but eventually falling into Russian hands. Russia has already taken nearly 90% of the Donbas – made up of the regions of Luhansk and Donetsk - but its advances this year have all but stalled in the face of strong Ukrainian resistance. The White House is sounding positive about the revived talks in Abu Dhabi, despite Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky's refusal to cede the territory. October was the deadliest month for Russian troops since the start of its full-scale invasion – with more than 54,000 killed or injured, according to Ukraine's general staff. Despite this, Russian forces are still making life in the Fortress Belt cities almost impossible. Before the war, Slovyansk was a city of more than 200,000 people. Less than 10% of those remain and the population diminishes by the day. But amid the wail of near constant air raid warnings, there are still signs of people clinging on to life here. Iryna works in one of the city's last remaining coffee shops. Slovyansk is where she was born. "I'm forced to walk around crying," she tells me. "How can they do this?" Life, she says, has become incredibly difficult. She has already lost her house. But despite her tears, there is still defiance: "I won't leave Slovyansk. This is my home." Inga, 53, was also born and raised here and continues to work in the city despite the danger. "It's stressful. Honestly, I don't even know what to say," she says, but she is staying because of what she calls the "fear of the unknown". "I simply have nowhere to go, and I don't have the money to leave or support myself afterwards." Nor, she says, is there anywhere else in Ukraine she would consider truly safe. We first met the Omega National Guard Special Forces drone unit two years ago fighting in the Kharkiv region, in north-eastern Ukraine. Just four of the original team remain - the rest have moved to other units, or they have been wounded or killed. Among the dead was the brother of the man in charge of the unit, Oleksandr, who now describes his unit as his family. He jokes it is just like the Peaky Blinders TV show – "but without the crime and the drugs". Back at their base they share a meal every evening. Oleksandr reads out a prayer of thanks for surviving another day – he says it strengthens their spirits. The meal is accompanied by classical music played on a speaker. It helps drown out the noise of the explosions nearby. "I feel this is the most difficult situation we've ever faced," says Oleksandr, who underlines the importance of holding the line. "We must be here to inflict maximum damage on the enemy. We're fighting here because this is where the most intense phase of the war is taking place. Russia's claim that they will reach the borders of the Donbas, seize it, and then the war will end is absolutely false," he insists. The remaining fortress belt cities provide Ukraine with a strong defensive line and are a major obstacle to any Russian advance. The saturation of drones in the area is also now making it nigh-on impossible for either side to advance here. Peace talks may have resumed, but Oleksandr notes they have not led to anything so far. "I really want this war to end," he says, "but do I believe these negotiations will succeed? No, I don't really believe they will". The next morning we are not the only ones making an exit. A dozen civilians have arrived at an evacuation point in the centre to be escorted out. They hold all the belongings they can carry and are taken into a bunker for their safety. Outside there is another heavy blast of small arms fire, signalling more drones are nearby. Alina Shyrko, herself a resident of Slovyansk, is co-ordinating the move of civilians out of the city and says the situation has deteriorated rapidly over the past few months. Families with children have already been ordered to leave. "Everyone is thinking about leaving," she says, "I'm thinking about it too." Ukraine still holds Slovyansk but its lifeblood, its people, are ebbing away. Additional reporting by Rebecca Hartmann and Volodymyr Lozhko.

news.title: Some pupils 'struggling just to get a hot meal'
news.summary: Students speak out as school dinner prices are set to increase for the second time in a year.

news.titleTr: Some pupils 'struggling just to get a hot meal'
news.summaryTr: Students speak out as school dinner prices are set to increase for the second time in a year.
news.articleText: Some pupils 'struggling just to get a hot meal' - Published The increasing price of school dinners in Northern Ireland has left some pupils "struggling just to get a hot meal," one teenage student has said. Robert-Frederic, 17, is among pupils at Belfast's Malone Integrated College who spoke out after it was announced prices are to rise for the second year in a row. Post-primary pupils will pay an extra 15% on their canteen choices from January, while set meals at pre-school, primary and special schools will rise by 30p. The Education Authority (EA) said the amount parents would have to pay was still well below the average cost of producing a school meal, estimated at over £5.20. Families recently had to set aside extra money for term-time meals after primary and special school dinners increased by 50p in January 2026. At that time, post-primary pupils were informed they would pay almost 20% more for the food they bought in school canteens. Robert-Frederic told BBC News NI that the previous increase had already made paying for lunches "more difficult for all students". "Back before the price rise in 2026, you could get water, a cookie and your hot meal and now with the price rise students are struggling just to get a hot meal," he said. "Instead of just going off numbers on a page, you should actually see how it affects people." 'Pressure on parents' More than half (55%) of pupils at Malone Integrated College are entitled to free school meals but many others are from low incomes households. "It's horrible seeing people around me not being able to afford school meals," said 17-year-old Naomi. "It also puts pressure on the parents," she added. "Without proper lunches it can affect people's learning and their mental health." For 16-year-old Paddy, the last price hike meant he had to change his canteen choices at Malone. "Some of my favourite foods such as like the school chicken - that went up," he said. "It was around £2.20 and now it's £2.60. "And as a student that felt like I should prioritise getting to school because I only get £5 a day and £2.50 of that has to go towards getting the bus." The school's headteacher, Áine Leslie, said the price rise will put further pressure on families who are already worried about the cost of living crisis. "I think the cumulative effect of this will be immense, particularly families who have multiple children, both at a primary school and a post-primary school, and trying to make ends meet, it's going to become incredibly difficult," she said. When the prices increased earlier this year, she remembers "sitting with the head of the cafeteria and heartbreakingly decide how much to put up each item". She said some students would be "worried about the stigma attached to this, and won't voice their concerns and won't ask for help" which was "really sad". Leslie added that not having a healthy, balanced diet or going without food will be a "barrier to learning". How much do school dinners cost in NI? The latest increase means the price of a paid for dinner in a primary school or special school, for instance, will have risen from £2.60 to £3.40 since the start of 2026. Pupils eligible for free school meals will not be affected. The rise in school dinner prices is not the only measure introduced by the EA in response to what they describe as "an exceptionally challenging financial position". There will also be a change to some menus in schools, replacing baked desserts with cheaper alternatives. Why are school dinner prices going up? Education Minister Paul Givan said he was disappointed and concerned but added it was due to underfunding of the education sector as a whole. "I don't want this to be introduced, but it is a result of the Education Authority not having sufficient funding," he told the BBC's Good Morning Ulster programme. He said education often bears "the greatest burden" during cost-saving exercises and argued his department should receive a greater share of Stormont's budget. Givan also said the "inadequate" funding that Stormont receives from Westminster was "bearing down on a huge number of public services in Northern Ireland". Stormont ministers are yet to agree a budget, despite weeks of talks with Secretary of State Sir Chris Bryant, who has repeatedly said there is "no more money". At Omagh High School in County Tyrone, almost 30% of pupils have free school meals. For the families who have to pay, putting the price up could deter those children having "nutritious meals" according to its principal, Christos Gaitatzis. He told BBC News NI that the 15% hike was excessive. "What is the price index at the moment – is it 3,4, 5%? I would imagine that would be the reasonable increase that you would put on anything. "So they are going three times the value - to me it is unreasonable." He said the rise would have an "overall future impact on the health of the kids". 'Flabbergasted' Northern Ireland's Commissioner for Children and Young People, Chris Quinn, said he was ''flabbergasted" at the change. "School meals are not a luxury. For many children they are an essential part of the school day, and these increases will hit hardest those families already struggling with the cost of living." Quinn added it was "particularly difficult to accept" another price hike shortly after the EA advised staff and pupils to "wear more clothes" to cut school heating bills. "Children did not create the financial crisis in education and they should not be expected to pay the price for it," he added. What other costs are increasing? Payments which subsidise milk at about 500 schools are at risk, but the EA is to seek funding from the Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs. The EA is also planning to offer more parents payments to transport their children to school rather than paying for taxis. At present, some parents receive payments if their children are eligible for free school transport but no private providers, like taxis, are available. Charges for EA music lessons for pupils are also set to rise again. 'These were difficult decisions' The EA said it was being asked to deliver services "with insufficient funding" at a time when costs, such as providing energy for schools, continued to rise. It said it hoped to save £20m by introducing the measures on top of £30m saved this year. "These were difficult decisions which sought to balance our commitment to children and young people alongside the requirement to live within the funding allocated for the year." - Published14 January - Published5 November 2025

news.titleTr: Pegasus (PGSUS) KAP'a duyurdu: Yolcu trafiği 37,6 milyona dayandı!
news.summaryTr: Pegasus'un toplam yolcu sayısı Ekim 2026'da geçen yılın aynı ayına göre yüzde 4 artarak 4,21 milyon oldu. Ocak-ekim döneminde taşınan yolcu sayısı ise yüzde 5 yükselişle 37,64 milyona çıktı.
news.articleText: Pegasus (PGSUS) KAP'a duyurdu: Yolcu trafiği 37,6 milyona dayandı! - Pegasus'un toplam yolcu sayısı Ekim 2026'da geçen yılın aynı ayına göre yüzde 4 artarak 4,21 milyon oldu. Ocak-ekim döneminde taşınan yolcu sayısı ise yüzde 5 yükselişle 37,64 milyona çıktı. Pegasus Hava Taşımacılığı (PGSUS), 2026 yılı Ekim ayına ilişkin trafik sonuçlarını ve karbon emisyonu istatistiklerini Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'nda (KAP) yayımladı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Şirketin açıkladığı verilere göre ekim ayında toplam yolcu sayısı yıllık bazda yüzde 4 artışla 4,21 milyona yükseldi. Aynı dönemde arz edilen koltuk sayısı yüzde 4 artarak 4,78 milyona, arz edilen koltuk kilometre (ASK) ise yüzde 2 yükselişle 7 milyar 588 milyona ulaştı. Buna karşın doluluk oranı geçen yılın aynı ayına göre 0,5 puan gerileyerek yüzde 88,2 oldu. İç hat yolcu sayısı yüzde 14 arttı Ekim ayında iç hatlarda taşınan yolcu sayısı yıllık yüzde 14 artışla 1,55 milyona çıktı. İç hatlarda arz edilen koltuk sayısı yüzde 11 artarak 1,66 milyona yükselirken, doluluk oranı 2,2 puan artışla yüzde 93,4'e ulaştı. Dış hatlarda ise yolcu sayısı yüzde 1 düşüşle 2,66 milyon oldu. Bu hatta doluluk oranı 2,1 puan gerileyerek yüzde 85,4 olarak gerçekleşti. 10 ayda 37,64 milyon yolcu taşındı Pegasus'un Ocak-Ekim 2026 dönemindeki toplam yolcu sayısı, geçen yılın aynı dönemine göre yüzde 5 artarak 37,64 milyona ulaştı. Bu dönemde arz edilen koltuk sayısı yüzde 6 artışla 43,67 milyona, ASK yüzde 4 yükselişle 67 milyar 991 milyona çıktı. Toplam doluluk oranı ise 1,3 puan düşerek yüzde 86,2 oldu. İç hatlarda 10 aylık yolcu sayısı yüzde 13 artışla 14,53 milyona yükselirken, dış hatlarda yolcu sayısı yüzde 0,3 civarında gerileyerek 23,11 milyon seviyesinde gerçekleşti. Karbon emisyonu göstergesi geriledi Pegasus'un karbon emisyonu istatistiklerinde de düşüş kaydedildi. Ekim 2026'da CO2 gram/RPK göstergesi 55,3 olarak gerçekleşirken, geçen yılın aynı ayında 55,9 seviyesindeydi. Ocak-Ekim döneminde ise söz konusu gösterge 56,8'e geriledi. Geçen yılın aynı döneminde bu değer 57,1 olarak kaydedilmişti.

news.title: Halkbank (HALKB), Halk Katılım Bankası'nı 14,8 milyar TL'ye TVF'ye devretti
news.summary: Halkbank, sermayesinin yüzde 99,99'una sahip olduğu Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki paylarının tamamını TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları A.Ş.'ye devretti. 14,8 milyar TL'lik işlem sonucunda bankanın 39,9 milyon TL satış kârı oluştu.

news.titleTr: Halkbank (HALKB), Halk Katılım Bankası'nı 14,8 milyar TL'ye TVF'ye devretti
news.summaryTr: Halkbank, sermayesinin yüzde 99,99'una sahip olduğu Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki paylarının tamamını TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları A.Ş.'ye devretti. 14,8 milyar TL'lik işlem sonucunda bankanın 39,9 milyon TL satış kârı oluştu.
news.articleText: Halkbank (HALKB), Halk Katılım Bankası'nı 14,8 milyar TL'ye TVF'ye devretti - Halkbank, sermayesinin yüzde 99,99'una sahip olduğu Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki paylarının tamamını TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları A.Ş.'ye devretti. 14,8 milyar TL'lik işlem sonucunda bankanın 39,9 milyon TL satış kârı oluştu. Türkiye Halk Bankası (HALKB), Halk Katılım Bankası A.Ş.'deki paylarının devrini tamamladığını Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) bildirdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Banka tarafından yapılan açıklamaya göre, Halk Katılım Bankası'nın yüzde 99,99 oranındaki paylarının TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları A.Ş.'ye devredilmesi için Bankacılık Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu'ndan (BDDK) 22 Ekim 2026 tarihinde izin alındı. Pay devir işlemleri 10 Kasım 2026 itibarıyla tamamlandı. İşlem tutarı 14,8 milyar TL oldu Devir kapsamında nominal değeri 11 milyar 499 milyon 999 bin 996 TL olan paylar satıldı. İşlemin toplam tutarı 14 milyar 799 milyon 999 bin 995,72 TL olarak açıklandı. Pay başına satış fiyatı ise 1,2870 TL oldu. İşlem sonucunda Halkbank'ın 39 milyon 923 bin 999,72 TL satış kârı elde ettiği bildirildi. Halkbank'ın iştiraki kalmadı Devir sonrasında Halkbank'ın Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki iştirak oranı ve oy hakkı sıfıra indi. Böylece banka, Halk Katılım Bankası'ndaki paylarının tamamını devretmiş oldu. KAP açıklamasında, satış işleminin Halkbank'ın faaliyetleri üzerinde herhangi bir etkisinin bulunmadığı belirtildi. Alıcı şirket aynı ana hissedara sahip Halk Katılım Bankası'nın sermayesi 11,5 milyar TL olarak açıklanırken, alıcı TVF Katılım Finans Yatırımları A.Ş.'nin Halkbank ile aynı ana hissedarlık yapısına sahip olduğu bildirildi. İşleme ilişkin sözleşme 7 Ekim 2026 tarihinde imzalandı. Satış bedelinin belirlenmesinde özkaynak yöntemi kullanılırken, ayrıca bir değerleme raporu hazırlanmadı.

news.titleTr: İmzalar atıldı: Türkiye ile Suudi Arabistan'dan 5 bin megavatlık yeni enerji hamlesi
news.summaryTr: Türkiye ile Suudi Arabistan, yenilenebilir enerji yatırımlarını genişletmek amacıyla yeni bir mutabakat zaptı imzaladı. Anlaşma kapsamında 3 bin megavatlık ilave kapasite için rüzgar santralleri, enerji depolama ve iletim altyapısı projeleri geliştirilecek.
news.articleText: İmzalar atıldı: Türkiye ile Suudi Arabistan'dan 5 bin megavatlık yeni enerji hamlesi - Türkiye ile Suudi Arabistan, yenilenebilir enerji yatırımlarını genişletmek amacıyla yeni bir mutabakat zaptı imzaladı. Anlaşma kapsamında 3 bin megavatlık ilave kapasite için rüzgar santralleri, enerji depolama ve iletim altyapısı projeleri geliştirilecek. Türkiye ile Suudi Arabistan arasında enerji alanındaki stratejik işbirliğini derinleştirecek yeni bir adım atıldı. Cumhurbaşkanı Recep Tayyip Erdoğan'ın Suudi Arabistan Enerji Bakanı Abdulaziz bin Salman Al Saud'u kabulünün ardından, iki ülke arasında Elektrik Projelerinde İşbirliğine İlişkin Mutabakat Zaptı imzalandı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Enerji ve Tabii Kaynaklar Bakanı Alparslan Bayraktar, imzaların Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan'ın huzurunda atıldığını duyurdu. 5 bin megavatlık yatırımın ilk aşaması başladı Bayraktar'ın açıklamasına göre, 3 Şubat'ta Riyad'da imzalanan ve 21 Ekim'de yürürlüğe giren hükümetler arası anlaşmayla, ACWA Power'ın Türkiye'de iki aşamada geliştireceği toplam 5 bin megavatlık yenilenebilir enerji projelerinin çerçevesi oluşturuldu. Yatırım programının ilk aşamasında Sivas ve Karaman'da toplam 2 bin megavatlık güneş enerjisi projeleri bulunuyor. Bayraktar, bu projelerde kaydedilen ilerlemeden memnuniyet duyduklarını belirtti. İkinci aşamada rüzgar ve enerji depolama yatırımları Antalya'da imzalanan yeni mutabakatla, ikinci aşamada hedeflenen 3 bin megavatlık ilave kapasiteye yönelik çalışmaların hızlandırılması amaçlanıyor. Bu kapsamda yüksek gerilim doğru akım (HVDC) iletim altyapısıyla desteklenen rüzgar enerjisi santrallerinin geliştirilmesi ve batarya enerji depolama sistemlerinin kurulması öngörülüyor. Şebeke altyapısı da güçlendirilecek Planlanan yatırımların yalnızca yenilenebilir enerji üretim kapasitesini artırmakla sınırlı kalmayacağı, Türkiye'nin elektrik şebekesinin güçlendirilmesine ve sistem esnekliğinin geliştirilmesine de katkı sağlaması hedefleniyor. Bayraktar, yatırımlarla Türkiye'nin enerji dönüşümüne ve yatırım ortamına duyulan güveni somut projelere dönüştürmeye devam edeceklerini ifade etti.

news.title: Arrests made in Mohamed Al Fayed probe in France, police say
news.summary: The Ritz hotel in Paris, which is still owned by the Al Fayed family, is one of the properties searched by police.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Arrests made in Mohamed Al Fayed probe in France, police say
news.summaryTr: The Ritz hotel in Paris, which is still owned by the Al Fayed family, is one of the properties searched by police.
news.articleText: Arrests made in Mohamed Al Fayed probe in France, police say - Published French police have made arrests after three properties, including the Ritz hotel in Paris, were searched in relation to an investigation into Mohamed Al Fayed's abuse. The Paris prosecutor's office told the BBC that several individuals were taken into custody for questioning last month and later released. In a confidential letter sent to survivors, the Metropolitan Police said its officers were present during the searches on 13 and 14 October, in what is understood to be a joint operation between British and French authorities. It is the first time any arrests have been made in relation to alleged abuse and trafficking by the former Harrods and Ritz owner. - Mohamed Al Fayed accused of multiple rapes by staff - Published19 September 2024 Several victims of Al Fayed were also interviewed by French investigators, the prosecutor's office said. It added that the searches were part of a preliminary investigation into "allegations of human trafficking committed by an organized group, aggravated pimping committed by an organized group, and rape". The investigation is ongoing and digital material seized during the searches is being analysed. The late Egyptian billionaire bought the Ritz Paris hotel in 1979, and it is still owned by the Al Fayed family. The Villa Windsor in western Paris, another property involved in the search, was a holiday home for the Al Fayed family. It was previously the home of King Edward VIII, following his abdication, and his wife Wallis Simpson. The Met shared this statement from French authorities with victims: "At this stage of the proceedings, several victims have been interviewed by French investigators, and the investigations are being conducted in liaison with the British authorities. "In this context, searches and evidence-gathering operations were carried out in mid-October 2026, notably within the Hotel Ritz in the 1st arrondissement of Paris, as well as at the Villa Sainte-Thérèse in Saint-Tropez, a former property of Mohamed Al Fayed, and at the Villa Windsor in the 16th arrondissement of Paris, in the presence of British investigators. "Several suspects were taken into police custody, measures which were lifted following their interviews, specifically for the purpose of analyzing digital material seized during the search operations. "The investigations are continuing under the direction of the Paris Public Prosecutor's Office." A Met Police spokesperson confirmed its officers travelled to France in October and were present during the operation. Al Fayed, who died in 2023 aged 94, was accused by more than 20 women of sexual assault in a BBC documentary and podcast in September 2024. One of the women featured in the documentary said she was sexually assaulted by Al Fayed at the Ritz hotel in Paris, while another woman said she had been raped by him at the Villa Windsor residence. Since those allegations, more than 400 alleged victims or witnesses have come forward to lawyers. A woman has also told BBC Scotland she was trafficked, drugged, sexually assaulted and held prisoner on the Balnagown Estate by Al Fayed's brother, Salah Fayed, who died in 2010. Both brothers died without facing legal charges in relation to these allegations. Earlier this year, Police Scotland said it was carrying out further investigations into allegations connected to Balnagown Estate. In a statement, a force spokesperson said: "Three people have been identified in connection with offending against a number of victims. "Our inquiries are ongoing and it would be inappropriate to comment further." The Justice for Fayed and Harrods Survivors group said it welcomed the "significant developments" and cooperation between the Met and French authorities. "We believe that all properties owned by Fayed should be investigated with the same thoroughness as those already searched, wherever they are located, to ensure that no potentially relevant evidence is overlooked," the group said. "We hope these developments represent meaningful progress towards identifying and holding to account all those who facilitated, concealed or assisted his offending, wherever they operated." The survivor advocacy group No One Above said: "France is treating this as organised human trafficking, led by specialists, with properties searched and evidence seized. That is what a serious investigation into a network looks like. "Two years on, survivors are still waiting for the same from the Met. It is time the National Crime Agency took this investigation over." The management of the Ritz Paris told AFP news agency that it "does not tolerate any form of harassment, abuse or inappropriate behaviour" and that it was ready "to cooperate fully with the competent judicial authorities". If you have been affected by any of the issues raised in this story, information and support is available at BBC Action Line. - Published27 September 2024 - Published24 August

news.title: “Hortlak Kızın Hikayesi” Kasım'da Farklı Sahnelerde Seyirciyle Buluşuyor
news.summary: Anadolu’nun kadın hafızasından beslenen, kara mizah ile gotik anlatıyı buluşturan “Hortlak Kızın Hikayesi”, 24 Ekim’de DasDas Açık Sahne’de yeni sezonunu açtı. Oyun, Kasım ayında ilk kez Beyoğlu’nda, istos Sahne Aznavur’da seyirciyle buluşmaya hazırlanıyor.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: “Hortlak Kızın Hikayesi” Kasım'da Farklı Sahnelerde Seyirciyle Buluşuyor
news.summaryTr: Anadolu’nun kadın hafızasından beslenen, kara mizah ile gotik anlatıyı buluşturan “Hortlak Kızın Hikayesi”, 24 Ekim’de DasDas Açık Sahne’de yeni sezonunu açtı. Oyun, Kasım ayında ilk kez Beyoğlu’nda, istos Sahne Aznavur’da seyirciyle buluşmaya hazırlanıyor.
news.articleText: “Hortlak Kızın Hikayesi” Kasım'da Farklı Sahnelerde Seyirciyle Buluşuyor Türkiye ve İngiltere ortak yapımı “Hortlak Kızın Hikayesi”, 19 Haziran’da Londra’daki Collective Theatre’da gerçekleşen ön gösteriminin ve 25 Haziran’da DasDas’ta gerçekleşen Türkiye prömiyerinin ardından yeni sezonuna başladı. Yazar Derem Çıray’ın kaleme aldığı, yönetmenliğini Işık Kaya’nın üstlendiği oyun, Cazu karakterine hayat veren Iraz Akçam’ın tek kişilik performansıyla sahneye taşınıyor. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle On yedi yaşındaki Cazu’nun ölümünün ardından başlayan sıra dışı yolculuğunu konu alan oyun, kuşaklar boyunca susturulan, dışlanan ve “öteki” ilan edilen kadınların hikâyelerini fantastik ve gotik bir anlatı üzerinden ele alıyor. Ölüm sebebini bilmediği için öteki dünyaya kabul edilmeyen Cazu, bir hortlak olarak yaşayanların arasına geri döner. Ölümünün ardındaki gerçeği ararken, bir yandan da kendisine anlatılan hikâyelerin izini sürer ve kendi hikâyesini yeniden yazmaya başlar. “Hortlak Kızın Hikayesi”, bastırılmış kadın seslerini oyuna özgü bestelenen şarkıların desteğiyle de sahneye taşıyarak seyirciyi karanlık, şiirsel ve düşündürücü bir yolculuğa davet ediyor. Tek kişilik performansıyla oyunun merkezinde yer alan Iraz Akçam’a, farklı karakterleri seslendiren sanatçıların kayıtları eşlik ediyor. Deneysel anlatım dili, fiziksel performans öğeleri, müzik ve kara mizahın iç içe geçtiği yapım, kendine özgü sahne diliyle güncel tiyatronun disiplinlerarası yaklaşımını bir araya getiriyor. 60 dakika ve tek perde olan “Hortlak Kızın Hikayesi”, 13 Kasım’da yeniden DasDas’ta sahnelenecek ve 15 Kasım’da ise ilk kez Beyoğlu’nda, istos Sahne Aznavur’da seyirciyle buluşacak.

Adalet Bakanı Akın Gürlek, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada fon soruşturmaları kapsamında yürütülen çalışmalara ilişkin bilgi verdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Suç yapılanmalarının mali bağlantılarının ve para hareketlerinin titizlikle incelendiğini belirten Gürlek, soruşturmalar kapsamında çok sayıda şüphelinin tutuklandığını, mal varlıklarına tedbir konulduğunu ve banka hesaplarının bloke edildiğini ifade etti. Tasfiye edilen fonlarda ödemeler başladı Yatırımcıların haklarının korunmasına yönelik çalışmaların devam ettiğini vurgulayan Gürlek, tasfiyesi tamamlanan fonlarda hak sahiplerine ödemelerin yapıldığını açıkladı. Diğer fonlara ilişkin işlemlerin ise sürdüğünü bildirdi. Gönüllü iadelerin hukuki sorumluluğu ortadan kaldırmayacağını belirten Gürlek, iyi niyetli yatırımcıların haklarının korunması, mağduriyetlerin giderilmesi ve suçtan elde edilen kazançların ortaya çıkarılması için ilgili kurumlarla koordineli çalışıldığını kaydetti. "Hiç kimsenin ekonomik gücü hukukun üzerinde değildir" Soruşturmaların kararlılıkla sürdürüleceğini belirten Gürlek, sorumluların adalet önünde hesap vermesi için sürecin takipçisi olacaklarını vurguladı. Gürlek, açıklamasında, "Hiç kimsenin makamı, unvanı veya ekonomik gücü kendisine hukukun üzerinde bir konum sağlayamaz. Ucu nereye giderse gitsin, sorumluların adalet önünde hesap vermesi için sürecin takipçisi olacağız." ifadelerini kullandı. Fon soruşturmaları kapsamında suç yapılanmalarının mali bağlantılarını ve para hareketlerini titizlikle araştırıyoruz. Çok sayıda şüpheli tutuklanırken malvarlıklarına tedbir uygulanmış, banka hesaplarına bloke konulmuştur. Tasfiyesi tamamlanan fonlarda hak sahiplerine ödemeler yapılmış, diğer fonlara ilişkin çalışmalar sürdürülmektedir. Gönüllü iadelerin hukuki sorumluluğu ortadan kaldırmayacağını özellikle vurguluyoruz. İyi niyetli yatırımcılarımızın haklarını korumak, mağduriyetleri gidermek ve suçtan elde edilen kazançları ortaya çıkarmak için tüm ilgili kurumlarımızla koordinasyon içinde çalışıyoruz. Hiç kimsenin makamı, ünvanı veya ekonomik gücü kendisine hukukun üzerinde bir konum sağlayamaz. Ucu nereye giderse gitsin, sorumluların adalet önünde hesap vermesi için sürecin takipçisi olacağız. 📍 TBMM Plan ve Bütçe Komisyonu — Akın Gürlek (@abakingurlek) November 10, 2026

news.title: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
news.summary: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes
news.summaryTr: The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list.
news.articleText: Poland’s lower house backs sanctions bill covering crypto freezes The bill is now before the Senate and would broaden the grounds for adding people and companies to Poland’s national sanctions list. Poland’s lower house passed a bill that would broaden the country’s sanctions framework and explicitly include crypto assets among the funds authorities can freeze when imposing sanctions. The Sejm approved the government-backed Act on Restrictive Measures on Friday by 240 votes to 202, with one abstention, and forwarded it to the Senate on Monday, according to official parliamentary records. The bill explicitly includes crypto assets, as defined under the European Union’s Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA), among financial funds that authorities could freeze when imposing sanctions. Poland’s interior minister would oversee the national sanctions list, with sanctions-listing decisions taking effect the day after authorities publish a designation. Affected individuals and companies could challenge the decision in administrative court, but the bill allows enforcement before a court ruling. Poland already maintains a national sanctions list under a 2022 law aimed at countering support for Russia’s invasion of Ukraine. The bill would expand the grounds for imposing national sanctions to include certain foreign interference and information manipulation that pose a serious threat to national security. The Senate has 30 days to approve, amend or reject the legislation. If it takes no action, Poland’s Constitution treats the bill as approved in the form passed by the Sejm, allowing it to proceed to the president for consideration. Related: US Treasury cuts off MEXC over alleged $16B in illicit transactions

news.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Here’s what happened in crypto today
news.summaryTr: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
news.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Coinbase and Kalshi have joined four other firms backing the CFTC in a lawsuit over whether US exchanges can list perpetual futures tied to individual stocks, cybersecurity firm CertiK urged exchanges to impose hard dollar limits on hot-wallet holdings following the $6.3 billion Binance hack, and blockchain analytics firm Elliptic reported that North Korean hackers used newly created memecoins to launder stolen funds. Coinbase, Kalshi join lawsuit backing CFTC over US stock perp futures Coinbase, Kalshi and four other companies asked a federal court Monday to accept a brief backing the United States Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) in a lawsuit over perpetual futures tied to individual US stocks. According to a proposed amicus brief shared Monday by Coinbase legal representative Molly Abraham, the group also includes Kraken parent Payward, trading companies DRW Holdings and Jump Trading, and crypto investment company Paradigm Operations. The companies argue that stock perpetual futures fall under existing US futures laws. The filing comes days after a federal judge found that the CFTC likely “exceeded its statutory authority” in allowing single-stock perpetuals to trade as security futures. The case could determine whether US exchanges can offer retail traders contracts that track individual stocks without expiring. On Nov. 3, the CFTC announced that single-stock perpetual futures, or stock perps, could begin trading on US-regulated exchanges for the first time. The Capital Markets Alliance Association (CMAA), a newly formed trade and advocacy group representing traditional financial market participants and whose members include Cboe and Citadel Securities, sued the CFTC last week, challenging the CFTC’s authority to allow the contracts to trade. Crypto exchanges need dollar caps on hot wallets, CertiK says Crypto exchanges should impose hard dollar limits on their hot-wallet holdings rather than relying solely on cold-storage ratios to measure security, according to cybersecurity firm CertiK. The recommendation came as several crypto exchanges recently disclosed how much they held in cold wallets, seeking to reassure customers after the record Binance hack that targeted its hot wallets. Crypto exchange Gate reported that 88.26% of its total assets were in cold storage, while Coinbase said it keeps more than 99% of customer assets offline. “Cold storage is a useful measure of online exposure, but it is not a standalone security score,” CertiK’s research team told Cointelegraph. CertiK said crypto exchanges should consider setting hot-wallet caps for each asset and blockchain according to the strictest of three limits: a percentage of customer liabilities, estimated withdrawal needs and an absolute loss ceiling based on the exchange’s financial resources and recovery capabilities. “Flexibility should support operating liquidity, while hard dollar ceilings and circuit breakers limit potential loss,” they said. North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic North Korean hackers created memecoins to launder cryptocurrency stolen in the $6.3 billion Binance hack, routing roughly $430,000 through six newly launched tokens on the NEAR blockchain, according to a report from blockchain analytics firm Elliptic. Between Nov. 5 and 7, the hackers created at least six tokens on NEAR and used liquidity pools on decentralized exchanges to move stolen funds between wallets, Elliptic said. The tokens attracted almost no outside trading and were abandoned shortly after launch. The hackers used one set of wallets to swap stolen NEAR tokens for the new memecoins, then used another set to sell those memecoins back into the pools for NEAR. The swaps let them move funds without direct wallet-to-wallet transfers, though the transactions remained traceable onchain. Elliptic said the same laundering technique was also used following the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, when North Korean-linked actors moved at least $24 million through a newly created token on the TRON blockchain.

news.title: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
news.summary: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.
news.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
news.titleTr: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
news.summaryTr: Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027.
news.articleText: Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027. Wall Street’s embrace of Bitcoin has created the “best buying opportunity ever,” according to investor Mark Moss. Moss co-founded the Bitcoin Opportunity Fund, where he is an advisory partner. In 2025, UK-listed Satsuma Technology appointed him chief Bitcoin strategist. Moss tells Cointelegraph on the latest episode of Trade Secrets that he first bought Bitcoin in 2015 at about $300, during a recovery from a $1,000 to $200 plunge. “It was so risky,” Moss recalls of buying back then. In contrast, today, “you have consensus from the US government and Wall Street.” “But most people still think it’s a scam,” he says. That skepticism opens buying opportunities as Bitcoin starts to cross what Moss calls the “chasm” between early adopters and mainstream investors. Banks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have made Bitcoin easier to buy and financial advisers could help persuade clients who have stayed away previously to consider investing. Related: Strategy shareholders approve daily dividends for four preferred stocks Moss calls bottom but Bitcoin keeps falling Bitcoin briefly climbed above $80,000 after the Democrats took control of the US Congress in the midterm elections, then gave back those gains as tech stocks sold off. By Friday, it fell to $74,762, its lowest level since August and remains in the doldrums at the time of writing. Despite the selloff, Moss points to the reaction to the $6.3 billion Binance hack as a sign that sellers were running out. “The price didn’t really drop,” he says. Bitcoin fell to $76,320 after the breach and slid to $74,762 on Friday, erasing its post-election gains. It fell further to about $73,500 late Sunday, its lowest level since August, after Nvidia’s board announced it would investigate reports that CEO Jensen Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. Bitcoin found another bottom after reports of Nvidia CEO’s scandal. Source: CoinMarketCap Flows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs swung sharply during election week. The funds took in about $75 million on Wednesday, then shed $430 million on Thursday. History is on the side of hodlers however. Bitcoin gained an average of about 53% in the 12 months after previous US midterms, Moss says, using data going back to 2014. That leaves three completed election cycles in his sample. He says he expects Bitcoin to set a new all-time high in 2027. Moss backs Strategy but would keep his Bitcoin Moss thinks the Bitcoin treasury company to own is Strategy (MSTR), but believes that holding Bitcoin yourself is still superior. Strategy began buying Bitcoin in 2020 and turned those purchases into a core part of its business. It has used stock and debt sales to fund its purchases, giving investors a way to bet on Bitcoin through a publicly traded company. By Nov. 2, Strategy held 849,327 BTC, more than 4% of Bitcoin’s maximum supply. “I don’t think there’s another publicly traded company that will outperform Strategy over the next ten years,” Moss says. Strategy has the world’s largest corporate Bitcoin trove. Source: BitcoinTreasuries.Net Leverage can help a Bitcoin treasury company’s shares outperform the cryptocurrency it holds when its price rises. But even if Strategy outperforms, Moss wouldn’t trade his Bitcoin holdings for its shares. Related: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold Before Moss bought his first Bitcoin, he made a living buying foreclosed properties, fixing them up and selling them. He moved into property development, then built and sold a medical equipment business. He says he put the proceeds into Southern California real estate. When the market crashed in 2008, he lost it all. “The reward of being right is not worth the risk of getting it wrong,” he says. Even with his outlook for Strategy, Moss says he’d keep his Bitcoin and use only a small share of his portfolio to pursue higher returns through treasury stocks. A journey of $1 million Bitcoin starts with small allocations In Moss’s model, Bitcoin could reach $1 million under certain circumstances, when it competes with stocks, bonds, gold and real estate for a considerable share of investors’ wealth. The model estimates how much those assets are worth, projects how that pool could grow as the global money supply expands and calculates a Bitcoin price based on the share it captures. Financial advisers could help bring in that money via one client’s portfolio at a time, encouraging them to shift a few percentage points out of stocks or bonds and into Bitcoin. The scenario depends on a critical mass of clients doing that, to the point where all those small allocations add up. The model also assumes Bitcoin stays secure and decentralized. Asked what could derail the scenario, Moss pointed to a failure that compromised either feature. Moss says $1 million is possible by 2030... though hodler’s might have to wait until 2032. Hodler’s Digest: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms

Bitcoin found another bottom after reports of Nvidia CEO’s scandal. Source: CoinMarketCap Flows into US spot Bitcoin ETFs swung sharply during election week. The funds took in about $75 million on Wednesday, then shed $430 million on Thursday. History is on the side of hodlers however. Bitcoin gained an average of about 53% in the 12 months after previous US midterms, Moss says, using data going back to 2014. That leaves three completed election cycles in his sample. He says he expects Bitcoin to set a new all-time high in 2027. Moss backs Strategy but would keep his Bitcoin Moss thinks the Bitcoin treasury company to own is Strategy (MSTR), but believes that holding Bitcoin yourself is still superior. Strategy began buying Bitcoin in 2020 and turned those purchases into a core part of its business. It has used stock and debt sales to fund its purchases, giving investors a way to bet on Bitcoin through a publicly traded company. By Nov. 2, Strategy held 849,327 BTC, more than 4% of Bitcoin’s maximum supply. “I don’t think there’s another publicly traded company that will outperform Strategy over the next ten years,” Moss says. Strategy has the world’s largest corporate Bitcoin trove. Source: BitcoinTreasuries.Net Leverage can help a Bitcoin treasury company’s shares outperform the cryptocurrency it holds when its price rises. But even if Strategy outperforms, Moss wouldn’t trade his Bitcoin holdings for its shares. Related: 1inch lawyer sees agencies driving US crypto regulation as midterms unfold Before Moss bought his first Bitcoin, he made a living buying foreclosed properties, fixing them up and selling them. He moved into property development, then built and sold a medical equipment business. He says he put the proceeds into Southern California real estate. When the market crashed in 2008, he lost it all. “The reward of being right is not worth the risk of getting it wrong,” he says. Even with his outlook for Strategy, Moss says he’d keep his Bitcoin and use only a small share of his portfolio to pursue higher returns through treasury stocks. A journey of $1 million Bitcoin starts with small allocations In Moss’s model, Bitcoin could reach $1 million under certain circumstances, when it competes with stocks, bonds, gold and real estate for a considerable share of investors’ wealth. The model estimates how much those assets are worth, projects how that pool could grow as the global money supply expands and calculates a Bitcoin price based on the share it captures. Financial advisers could help bring in that money via one client’s portfolio at a time, encouraging them to shift a few percentage points out of stocks or bonds and into Bitcoin. The scenario depends on a critical mass of clients doing that, to the point where all those small allocations add up. The model also assumes Bitcoin stays secure and decentralized. Asked what could derail the scenario, Moss pointed to a failure that compromised either feature. Moss says $1 million is possible by 2030... though hodler’s might have to wait until 2032. news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers
news.articleText: Release Number 9324-26 CFTC Sanctions Eight Individuals for Acting as Unregistered Associated Persons of Foreign Introducing Brokers November 09, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced eight orders filing and settling charges against Michael Talento, Anthony Tyler Williams, Quillan Roberto Black, Christopher Williams, Michael Levi Peters, Jordan Taylor Morgan, Lewis Matthew Neal, and Tyler Evan MacKechnie for acting as unregistered associated persons of unregistered foreign introducing brokers. According to the orders, the introducing brokers engaged in the solicitation of orders for off-exchange leveraged or margined retail foreign currency and retail commodities transactions with U.S. customers who were not eligible contract participants. The respondents solicited those customers without registering as associated persons of the introducing brokers, as required. Under the orders, the respondents must cease and desist from engaging in their illegal conduct. They also are barred for two years from registering with the Commission in any capacity or acting as a principal, agent, or employee of any CFTC registrant. Each order also recognizes the penalty the respondent owes in a related Securities and Exchange Commission proceeding. These orders relate to a prior Commission order sanctioning Netrios LP Ltd. and Red Acre Ltd. for facilitating illegal off-exchange commodity transactions with U.S. customers. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9263-26] The SEC has filed and settled charges against the respondents based on the same underlying conduct. The CFTC thanks the SEC for its assistance. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation
news.articleText: Release Number 9323-26 CFTC Issues Impartial Access Requirements Interpretation November 05, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today issued an interpretation (“Interpretation”) of the requirement that designated contract markets (“DCMs”) provide competitive, open, fair, and impartial access to their members and persons with trading privileges under Commission Regulation 38.151(b) (“Impartial Access Requirements”). “Derivatives markets must operate on a uniform basis at a national scale in order to achieve the purposes set out in the Commodity Exchange Act,” said Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Geographic access restrictions are inconsistent with those purposes and the Act’s impartial access requirements.” DCMs must cease domestic geographic restrictions that violate the Impartial Access Requirements within 30 days, or else submit to the Division of Market Oversight (“Division”) an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. Further, within 30 days, DCMs should ensure that intermediaries accessing their markets are not impeding and are complying with the DCM’s Impartial Access Requirements, or else submit to the Division an explanation for why such compliance is not feasible. The Commission will consider the facts and circumstances of any particular case in connection with potential Commission action. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
news.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9320-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Texas Man and His Company to Pay Over $13 Million in Commodities Fraud November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas entered a default judgment against defendants Walter Dunning Larrick III and Cambridge Financial Advisors LLC for their participation in a commodities fraud scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented they would use participant funds to trade futures and options, including those involving natural gas, oil, and gold; made material misrepresentations and omissions about the profitability of commodity trading with them; and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying Larrick’s personal expenses, and sending funds to offshore accounts in Costa Rica. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,767,625 civil monetary penalty and $3,255,875 in restitution. It also permanently enjoined them from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposed permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2023 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 8768-23.] -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures
news.articleText: Release Number 9319-26 CFTC Chairman Selig Releases Statement on Equity Perpetual Futures November 03, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig today released a statement announcing that perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities can begin trading for the first time on designated contract markets that are dually registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission as notice-registered national securities exchanges to trade security futures products. Key excerpts from Chairman Selig’s statement: “Today, perpetual futures contracts on individual equity securities (the ‘Equity Perps’) can begin trading for the first time on CFTC-registered exchanges. … “This expansion marks a significant step towards allowing U.S. market participants, consistent with applicable law, to avail themselves of the advantages of perpetual futures that have led to their emergence as widely sought tools for risk-management and price-discovery. I believe that bringing these types of innovative products into our regulated markets ensures that American investors and traders can access these products within the protections of the CFTC’s proven regulatory framework, rather than being forced to turn to offshore, and often unregulated, venues. … “The Equity Perps build on the foundation of the [Commodity Futures Modernization Act of 2000] and the [CFTC-SEC Memorandum of Understanding]. For too long, regulatory uncertainty left innovative products, such as security futures and equity perpetual futures, stranded in what SEC Chairman Paul S. Atkins has aptly described as a regulatory ‘no man’s land’ due to a lack of harmonization between the agencies. The CFTC and SEC have turned the page on that era, and are committed to delivering regulatory clarity for innovative products and a clear path to market, rather than more casualties of jurisdictional disputes.” Read Chairman Selig’s full statement here. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading
news.articleText: Release Number 9318-26 CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading October 28, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced it will host an industry roundtable Dec. 15 to discuss issues related to the viability of derivatives markets moving to 24/7 trading. The dialogue will build upon the CFTC’s Request for Comment earlier this summer on 24/7 trading. The CFTC’s roundtable will provide a public venue for dialogue on the evolving market structures shaping derivatives markets, including overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure and staffing needs, and operational readiness. Participants will convene from across the industry to discuss how the Commission can promote responsible innovation while protecting market participants and preserving the integrity and resilience of U.S. derivatives markets. “I have been consistently clear: under my leadership, the CFTC will not take a one‑size‑fits‑all approach to 24/7 trading. Market structure evolves best through thoughtful and responsible progress, and that’s exactly why we’re hosting a roundtable to hear directly from industry on their views for 24/7 trading across different asset classes,” Chairman Selig said. The roundtable will take place at CFTC’s headquarters in Washington. Information regarding the agenda, speakers, and registration will be posted at a later date. This event will be open to the public and livestreamed on CFTC.gov. Please note the number of in-person participants may be limited, and visitors will be subject to security checks. Members of the public are welcome to submit speaker nominations to [email protected]. -CFTC-

news.title: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026
news.articleText: Release Number 9317-26 ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — Last week, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the Risk Management Center at Kansas State University co-hosted the 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. The two-day conference brought together industry leaders, policymakers, and market participants to examine critical issues facing the agricultural economy, developments in derivatives markets, and the risk management tools American farmers, ranchers, and agribusinesses depend on. Conference Highlights CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig joined K-State President Richard Linton to welcome participants on opening day. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig addressed conference attendees, “I have spent a lot of time this year traveling around the country and talking to farmers and ranchers working hard each day to provide the food, feed, and fiber we depend on throughout our country and the world. I’ve met with farmers, ranchers, agribusinesses, and energy producers in Iowa, Texas, Nebraska, South Carolina, and Florida, and now, I’m with all of you here in Kansas.” [Watch Chairman Selig’s full remarks here.] Following Chairman Selig’s remarks, panelists examined the relationship between cash and derivatives markets, evolving commodity contracts, and the importance of effective hedging tools for agricultural producers. There were also panels where industry representatives addressed access to agricultural credit and the financial challenges facing producers and merchants. Additional afternoon discussions focused on rising production costs, fluctuating commodity prices, supply chain disruptions, and broader pressures on the farm economy. In addition, conference participants engaged in discussions about emerging market developments, including perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral, and their implications for agricultural risk management. CFTC Chief Advisor Alex Titus and White House Council of Economic Advisers Member Aaron Hedlund also examined the U.S. economic outlook, agricultural trade, and policies shaping American agriculture. The first day concluded with a keynote address from U.S. Department of Agriculture Deputy Secretary Stephen Vaden. U.S. Senator Roger Marshall of Kansas opened the second day with a morning keynote address on agricultural policy and legislative priorities facing American producers. The morning continued with discussions on agricultural prediction markets, the use of data in modern commodity markets, and developments in event contracts. In addition, panelists examined superintelligence, information advantages, and market integrity, including the implications of emerging technologies for market participants and regulators. Chairman Selig joined Futures Industry Association President and CEO Walt Lukken for a fireside chat examining the Commission’s priorities, the evolving regulatory landscape, and developments shaping derivatives markets. The conference concluded with discussions on enhancing public understanding of markets through data and customer education, followed by a panel examining clearing, market access, and the role of intermediaries in derivatives markets. Chairman Selig delivered closing remarks, concluding AgCon2026. -CFTC-
